intended_use: Create a repeatable, license-aware workflow for collecting beautiful presentation PPT/HTML references, reusable assets, and PPTX-to-HTML conversion plans for the presentation-agent project.
trigger_examples: 발표 에이전트용 예쁜 PPT와 HTML 발표 레퍼런스를 많이 모아줘.
Use presentation-reference-curator to collect deck design inspiration and decide which PPTX assets can be converted to HTML.
발표 자료를 만들기 전에 좋은 디자인 사례, 에셋 출처, 변환 가능성을 조사해서 카탈로그로 정리해줘.
forward_test_scenarios: Given a request to collect Korean startup pitch deck references, the skill should search first, record provenance and license status, keep unknown-license decks metadata-only, and produce a catalog update plus conversion plan.
Given a permitted local PPTX file, the skill should require source provenance before conversion and route it through the PPTX-to-HTML helper or a documented high-fidelity conversion research task.
improvement_ideas: Add automated screenshot-based visual quality scoring after the first real HTML slide reference set exists.
Add a license-page fetcher that records terms URLs and attribution requirements per source.
